name: Enamori Senri
source:
"...No matter what happens, I'll be happy to just stay by your side."

The only member of the Handicraft Club who has been around for a year already. She is quiet but whenever Senri talks, she says everything very straightly, almost even bluntly. She is honest about her feelings for Haruchika as well.
